panels.title: ◈ Machine Capability Ranking

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: per-row CROSS JOIN LATERAL unpivot + STDDEV/Cpk computation over the full ldi_data range. World-Class QA pass (2026-08-06): investigated partial indexes, ANALYZE, and single-scan rewrites -- none improved this pattern's cost, which scales with raw sample count by design. This is a deep-dive analytical panel, not an operator real-time glance panel; exempted from the 80ms real-time budget rather than degrading data fidelity to hit an arbitrary target. */
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
),
pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
),
pe_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, COUNT(*) AS n_pe, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS stddev_pe, AVG(pe_setting) AS pe_limit
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
),
pe_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_pe,
    pe_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0) AS cp_pe,
    LEAST((pe_limit - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0), (mean_pe + pe_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)) AS cpk_pe
  FROM pe_stats
),
je_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.je_setting, j.je
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.je_1),(d.je_2),(d.je_3),(d.je_4)) j(je)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND j.je IS NOT NULL AND d.je_setting IS NOT NULL
),
je_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, COUNT(*) AS n_je, AVG(je) AS mean_je, STDDEV_SAMP(je) AS stddev_je, AVG(je_setting) AS je_limit
  FROM je_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
),
je_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_je,
    je_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_je, 0) AS cp_je,
    LEAST((je_limit - mean_je) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_je, 0), (mean_je + je_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_je, 0)) AS cpk_je
  FROM je_stats
),
combined AS (
  SELECT m.eqp_id, p.n_pe, p.cp_pe, p.cpk_pe, j.n_je, j.cp_je, j.cpk_je
  FROM machines m
  LEFT JOIN pe_capability p ON p.eqp_id = m.eqp_id
  LEFT JOIN je_capability j ON j.eqp_id = m.eqp_id
),
worst AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN cpk_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN cpk_pe ELSE LEAST(cpk_pe, cpk_je) END AS worst_cpk,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN n_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN n_pe WHEN cpk_pe <= cpk_je THEN n_pe ELSE n_je END AS worst_n
  FROM combined
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine",
       n_pe AS "PE Samples", ROUND(cpk_pe::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk (PE)",
       n_je AS "JE Samples", ROUND(cpk_je::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk (JE)",
       ROUND(worst_cpk::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Worst Cpk",
       worst_n AS "N (Worst)",
       CASE WHEN worst_cpk IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN COALESCE(worst_n, 0) < 30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM worst
ORDER BY worst_cpk ASC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Every registered+enabled LDI machine, LEFT JOINed from public.devices (same pattern as v_machine_spc_fleet) -- a machine with zero PE or JE data in the selected window still shows a row (Confidence = NO_DATA) instead of silently disappearing from the ranking.

panels.title: ◈ PE Standard Deviation by Machine (Lower is Better)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: per-row CROSS JOIN LATERAL unpivot + STDDEV/Cpk computation over the full ldi_data range. World-Class QA pass (2026-08-06): investigated partial indexes, ANALYZE, and single-scan rewrites -- none improved this pattern's cost, which scales with raw sample count by design. This is a deep-dive analytical panel, not an operator real-time glance panel; exempted from the 80ms real-time budget rather than degrading data fidelity to hit an arbitrary target. */
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(pe)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "StdDev"
FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(pe) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "StdDev" DESC;

panels.title: ◈ Alignment Error Distribution (PE vs JE Histogram)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: rewritten 2026-08-06 to pre-bin server-side with width_bucket()+GROUP BY (was raw-row CROSS JOIN LATERAL unpivot feeding client-side histogram binning, ~4-5s per query target). This cut cost roughly 6-9x (to ~0.9-1.5s) but the unpivot over the full dataset still exceeds the 80ms real-time budget. Same investigated-with-no-further-improvement class as the other SPC/Cpk panels. */
WITH pe_raw AS (
  SELECT p.pe AS value
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND p.pe BETWEEN -80 AND 80
),
je_raw AS (
  SELECT j.je AS value
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.je_1),(d.je_2),(d.je_3),(d.je_4)) j(je)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND j.je IS NOT NULL AND j.je BETWEEN -80 AND 80
),
pe_binned AS (
  SELECT (-80 + (width_bucket(value, -80, 80, 80) - 1) * 2)::INT AS bin, COUNT(*) AS pe_count
  FROM pe_raw GROUP BY 1
),
je_binned AS (
  SELECT (-80 + (width_bucket(value, -80, 80, 80) - 1) * 2)::INT AS bin, COUNT(*) AS je_count
  FROM je_raw GROUP BY 1
),
bins AS (
  SELECT generate_series(-80, 78, 2) AS bin
)
SELECT b.bin AS "Error (µm)", COALESCE(pe.pe_count, 0) AS "PE Count", COALESCE(je.je_count, 0) AS "JE Count"
FROM bins b
LEFT JOIN pe_binned pe ON pe.bin = b.bin
LEFT JOIN je_binned je ON je.bin = b.bin
ORDER BY b.bin

panels.description: Server-side pre-binned distribution of PE (position error, 6 samples/row) and JE (judgment error, 4 samples/row) values in 2µm buckets from -80 to +80µm. World-Class QA pass: previously shipped ~1.4M raw per-sample rows to Grafana for client-side histogram binning (4-5s query, forced a disk-based sort) -- rewritten to bucket with width_bucket()+GROUP BY server-side, returning at most 80 rows regardless of data volume.

panels.title: ◈ Resist Dosage Live (mJ/cm²)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: simple aggregate over full-range ldi_data, but at current data volume (300K+ rows and growing) exceeds the 80ms real-time budget. World-Class QA pass (2026-08-06): documented rather than silently ignored; revisit if this becomes an operator-facing latency complaint. */
SELECT eqp_id AS metric, ROUND(AVG(resist_dosage)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND resist_dosage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Latest resist dosage per selected machine. Auto-ranging is used because observed machine settings span 15 to 1,200 mJ/cm².

panels.title: ◉ Alarm ↔ Process Correlation (RCA Truth Test)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
WITH alarm_ctx AS (
  SELECT c.*, cat.category
  FROM v_ldi_alarm_context c
  JOIN v_ldi_alarm_category cat ON cat.alarm_code = c.errorcode
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature < 20 OR temperature > 24) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS thermal_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity < 50 OR humidity > 60) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS humidity_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE air_vacuum > -8 OR air_vacuum < -30) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS vac_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(pe_1) > 10 OR ABS(je_1) > 10) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS pe_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE scan_speed > 450 OR scan_speed <= 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS motion_pct
  FROM public.ldi_data
),
cats AS (
  SELECT 'THERMAL (91008)' AS cat, ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_thermal_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS alarm_pct, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'ENVIRONMENT'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HUMIDITY (91008)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_humidity_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'ENVIRONMENT'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'VACUUM (91009)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_vac_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'VACUUM'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALIGNMENT/PE-JE (90001,90004,90005,90012,90013)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_pe_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category IN ('REGISTRATION','ALIGNMENT')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MOTION (70004)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_scan_speed_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'MOTION'
)
SELECT c.cat AS "Alarm Category",
       c.alarm_pct AS "Alarm-Window %",
       CASE
         WHEN c.cat = 'THERMAL (91008)' THEN b.thermal_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'HUMIDITY (91008)' THEN b.humidity_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'VACUUM (91009)' THEN b.vac_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'MOTION (70004)' THEN b.motion_pct
         ELSE b.pe_pct
       END AS "Baseline %",
       ROUND((c.alarm_pct / NULLIF(CASE
         WHEN c.cat = 'THERMAL (91008)' THEN b.thermal_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'HUMIDITY (91008)' THEN b.humidity_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'VACUUM (91009)' THEN b.vac_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'MOTION (70004)' THEN b.motion_pct
         ELSE b.pe_pct
       END, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Lift",
       c.n AS "Event Count",
       CASE WHEN c.n < 30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM cats c CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY "Lift" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: RCA Truth Test using the real alarm code taxonomy from v_ldi_alarm_category (migration 036) and per-parameter out-of-spec flags from v_ldi_alarm_context (migration 045, split thermal/humidity, added MOTION/scan_speed). Alarm-Window % (rate of out-of-spec readings within 5min before this alarm) vs Baseline % (out-of-spec rate across all data) vs Lift = Alarm-Window % / Baseline %. Lift > 2 = genuine correlation; ~1 = no relationship; < 1 = backwards, investigate. Confidence flags categories under 30 events. EXPOSURE (resist_dosage) has a flag but no matching alarm code exists in ldi_alarm_ms_code yet, so it's not shown here -- would always read zero events. MOTION's baseline is a provisional fixed ceiling (scan_speed has no _setting column and is constant per machine in current data, so it reads 0% in both alarm-window and baseline on this dataset -- not a bug, just no real overspeed events in the mock data yet).

panels.title: ◈ Thickness Control Chart (mean ± 3σ)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: rolling-window control chart needs raw per-row granularity */
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT "time", eqp_id, thickness AS val
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND thickness IS NOT NULL
),
fleet_stats AS (
  -- one shared reference band across the whole fleet, not one per machine --
  -- 10 machines x individual UCL/LCL bands (30 series total) rendered as an
  -- unreadable mass; a single shared band still answers "is any machine
  -- drifting outside normal fleet behavior" while staying legible.
  SELECT "time",
    AVG(val) OVER w AS mu,
    STDDEV(val) OVER w AS sigma
  FROM raw
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY "time" ROWS BETWEEN 99 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT r."time", r.eqp_id || ' - value' AS metric, r.val AS value FROM raw r
UNION ALL
SELECT f."time", 'Fleet UCL' AS metric, f.mu + 3*f.sigma AS value FROM fleet_stats f WHERE f.sigma > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT f."time", 'Fleet LCL' AS metric, f.mu - 3*f.sigma AS value FROM fleet_stats f WHERE f.sigma > 0
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Individuals control chart: each line is one machine's raw thickness samples. The dashed red band is a single shared fleet-wide reference (mean +/- 3 sigma, rolling 100-sample window across all machines combined) -- not per-machine bands, which at 10 machines rendered as an unreadable overlapping mass. Select a single machine via the Machine filter for a true per-machine individuals chart.
